slice: RPP-5ky selected flags-only MLINESTYLE retarget refusal
scope: Isolates a source-bound AC1027 MLINE retarget where only MLINESTYLE group 70 changes, proves atomic refusal and same-adapter retry after restoring the source flags. This qualifies a refusal guard only and does not implement changed-flag retarget support.

references.use: Group 70 bit 2 means display miters; bit 16 means start square end cap. The selected target changes 2 to 18, adding the square-start-cap flag while retaining display miters. This field definition does not prove native rendering or how consumer geometry should be regenerated.

Group 340 identifies the MLINESTYLE object and group 2 is the redundant style name. The test retargets both selected consumers by model references and the accepted retry verifies actual target identity and unchanged redundant names.

contract.admission: Runtime-authored AC1027 ASCII source with two MLINESTYLE records. The selected target record begins with flags 2, two elements, offsets [1.25,-0.75], and angles 90/90. Two source-bound MLINE consumers are requested to reference the target style.
contract.isolatedChange: Relative to the imported target-record baseline, its only typed/raw style-body edit is flags 2→18. This adds the documented bit 16 square-start-cap request while retaining the display-miters bit; style element count, offsets and angles remain unchanged. No consumer vertex, miter or segment-parameter edit is made.
contract.failureAndRetry: For ASCII and binary AC1027 output, the changed-flag request refuses, preserves a sentinel destination, and leaves the caller snapshot unchanged. Restoring flags 2 permits same-adapter retry. The retry's output proof checks the target style body and ownership, both MLINE references, unchanged redundant group-2 names, geometry/parameter fields and fresh readback.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. Inputs and outputs are authored at runtime in a temporary directory; successful runs remove them. No DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
contract.limits: The receipt proves only the exact AC1027 refusal boundary for flags 2→18 on the selected two-element, two-consumer profile, across ASCII/binary output. It does not qualify a successful changed-flag retarget, other flag combinations, other versions/carriers, native square-cap rendering, general MLINE geometry projection, complete document closure or a support claim.
